g.text: R102, C101 stacked on TSS3 pads
C102, R104 stacked on TSS1 pads
A = 0.1448·Vbus (τ 11 µs), B = 0.1426·Vbus (τ 47 ms). At 27 V: idle A−B +0.06 V, 3 V dip −0.35 V. Bus load 1.4 mA, max 1.8 mA.
module output (RO via Q2) → ESP32 RX / RMT input, 34 µs pulses
enable the MCU pull-up on that pin (on-board pull-up R11 is only 100k)
keep at logic high (or leave floating)
host supply; M1 powers the bus side
tap stops receiving; SCS bus sees ≤0.1 mA, no effect
R8: remove. R104 on the TSS1 pads replaces it (bottom of divider B).
F2 → R101 33.2k 0.1 %: Vishay SMM02040D3322BB300 MiniMELF (2 kV 1.2/50 µs).
F1 → R103 33k 0.1 %: Vishay MMA02040D3302BB300 MiniMELF. 0.1 % 1206 parts work too, with a lower surge rating.
R6 → 0 Ω. SHIELD = iso GND; terminal G = SCS BUS −.
GDT1, GDT2: remove. Once fired, a GDT across the 27 V bus supply would keep conducting.
TSS3 → R102 5.62k 0.1 % 1206 (ERA-8AEB5621V), C101 2.2 nF C0G/X7R 1206 stacked on it.
TSS1 → C102 10 µF ≥16 V X5R/X7R 1206, R104 5.49k 0.1 % 1206 (ERA-8AEB5491V) stacked on it.
R13 (100k, Q1 gate to GND): remove. If kept, IO1 must be driven high: open, it floats at ~1.65 V.
Grove IO1 (UART_Rx): keep at logic high or leave floating.
Grove IO2 (UART_Tx) → ESP32 RX, MCU pull-up enabled.
Link A and B: short wire between the JP1 A and B pads (bottom side).
